description: Atomically applies ordered exact-string edits to up to 50 files and 200 edits in total as one head version. Each `oldStr` must match once unless `replaceAll` is true, and any failing edit aborts the whole call. Set `dryRun` to validate and count replacements without committing. Takes the edit lease when no `leaseToken` is sent.

dryRun.description: Validate every edit and report the replacement counts without committing.

files.description: Files to edit (up to 50, and 200 edits in total). Every edit across every file commits as one version, or none of them do.

edits.description: Edits applied in order against the evolving content of this file.

oldStr.description: Exact text to find. Must match exactly once unless `replaceAll` is `true`.

replaceAll.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match.

name.description: Name of the file to edit. Singleton files are addressed by their type name, for example `global_css`.

leaseToken.description: Omit to have Cactal take the edit lease for you; pass a token from websiteSourceCode.lease.acquire to take over from another editor.

name: websiteSourceCode_files_strReplace
title: Edit source files with string replacement
